author: Telos I
title: Telos I - Test: SOTA + 2000 HVGs + No Scaling
abstract: This is a definitive experiment to test the 'sc.pp.scale artifact hypothesis'. It runs the full community SOTA pipeline using all 2000 HVGs, but with the `sc.pp.scale` step completely removed. If the score improves significantly over the 2000 HVG baseline and approaches the 1500 HVG SOTA, it would provide strong evidence that `sc.pp.scale` introduces artifacts when applied to a gene set with heterogeneous variance.
